paragraphs: Securing our frontier model training environment. OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.
保障我们的前沿模型训练环境。OpenAI 解释了我们如何加强前沿模型训练和评估的隔离措施，包括离线环境和高算力红队测试。
